This decline is attributed to a bond sell-off, a flattening yield curve, a potential UK economic slowdown, possible new 'windfall' taxes on banks, and AI disruption risks. Despite these concerns, the shares are considered inexpensive with a P/E ratio of eight and a 4%+ dividend yield, though the author prefers more diversified banks.
